min_disparity.description: Minimum possible disparity value. Normally 0, but can be negative for cameras with convergent optical axes.

sad_window_size.description: SAD (Sum of Absolute Differences) window size for BM algorithm. Must be odd, typically 5-21.

speckle_range.description: Maximum disparity variation within each connected component for speckle filtering.

speckle_window_size.description: Maximum size of smooth disparity regions to consider for speckle filtering. Set to 0 to disable speckle filtering.

uint16_scale_factor.description: Multiplier used ONLY when output_format is 'uint16_scaled'. e.g., if depth is in meters, a factor of 1000 converts it to millimeters to save as integers in PNG.

use_wls_filter.description: Apply Weighted Least Squares (WLS) filtering to smooth the disparity map while preserving edges. Requires computing disparity for both left and right images.

scale_factor.description: Pyramid decimation ratio, greater than 1. scaleFactor==2 means the classical pyramid, where each next level has 4x less pixels than the previous, but such a big scale factor will degrade feature matching scores dramatically. On the other hand, too close to 1 scale factor will mean that to cover certain scale range you will need more pyramid levels and so the speed will suffer.

score_type.description: The default HARRIS_SCORE (value=cv::ORB::HARRIS_SCORE) means that Harris algorithm is used to rank features (the score is written to KeyPoint::score and is used to retain best n_features features); FAST_SCORE (value=cv::ORB::FAST_SCORE) is alternative value of the parameter that produces slightly less stable key-points, but it is a little faster to compute.

wta_k.description: The number of points that produce each element of the oriented BRIEF descriptor. The default value 2 means the BRIEF where we take a random point pair and compare their brightnesses, so we get 0/1 response. Other possible values are 3 and 4. For example, 3 means that we take 3 random points (of course, those point coordinates are random, but they are generated from the pre-defined seed, so each element of BRIEF descriptor is computed deterministically from the pixel rectangle), find point of maximum brightness and output index of the winner (0, 1 or 2). Such output will occupy 2 bits, and therefore it will need a special variant of Hamming distance, denoted as NORM_HAMMING2 (2 bits per bin). When WTA_K=4, we take 4 random points to compute each bin (that will also occupy 2 bits with possible values 0, 1, 2 or 3).

cvat.description:
Detected object set reader using CVAT XML format.

CVAT XML format contains:
  - <annotations> root element
  - <image> elements with id, name, width, height
  - <box> elements with label, xtl, ytl, xbr, ybr
  - <polygon> elements with label and points

Coordinates are in absolute pixels.

default_confidence.description: Default confidence value for detections (CVAT does not store confidence).

dive.description:
Detected object set reader using DIVE JSON format.

DIVE JSON format contains:
  - tracks: object with track data indexed by ID
  - Each track: id, begin, end, confidencePairs, features
  - Each feature: frame, bounds [x1,y1,x2,y2], geometry
  - confidencePairs: [[label, score], ...]

See: https://kitware.github.io/dive/DataFormats/

yolo.description:
Detected object set reader using YOLO format.

YOLO format stores one .txt file per image with detections:
  class_id x_center y_center width height [confidence]

Coordinates are normalized [0,1] and converted using image dimensions.

For each image, the reader looks for the label file:
  1. Same directory as image (image.txt)
  2. ../labels/subdir/ directory relative to image
  3. ../labels/ directory relative to image

scale_factor.description: Pyramid decimation ratio, greater than 1. scaleFactor==2 means the classical pyramid, where each next level has 4x less pixels than the previous, but such a big scale factor will degrade feature matching scores dramatically. On the other hand, too close to 1 scale factor will mean that to cover certain scale range you will need more pyramid levels and so the speed will suffer.

score_type.description: The default HARRIS_SCORE (value=cv::ORB::HARRIS_SCORE) means that Harris algorithm is used to rank features (the score is written to KeyPoint::score and is used to retain best n_features features); FAST_SCORE (value=cv::ORB::FAST_SCORE) is alternative value of the parameter that produces slightly less stable key-points, but it is a little faster to compute.

wta_k.description: The number of points that produce each element of the oriented BRIEF descriptor. The default value 2 means the BRIEF where we take a random point pair and compare their brightnesses, so we get 0/1 response. Other possible values are 3 and 4. For example, 3 means that we take 3 random points (of course, those point coordinates are random, but they are generated from the pre-defined seed, so each element of BRIEF descriptor is computed deterministically from the pixel rectangle), find point of maximum brightness and output index of the winner (0, 1 or 2). Such output will occupy 2 bits, and therefore it will need a special variant of Hamming distance, denoted as NORM_HAMMING2 (2 bits per bin). When WTA_K=4, we take 4 random points to compute each bin (that will also occupy 2 bits with possible values 0, 1, 2 or 3).

Falls back to per-frame GPS placement when the fit is untrustworthy (few chained frames, low GPS spread, or high fit residual). Set false for the prior per-frame GPS placement.

export_homogs.description: Optional path to write the COMPLETE per-frame homography map (basename -> 3x3, npz) as soon as registration finishes. flight_log.description: Optional flight-log CSV or directory of daily FMCLOG CSVs. Empty = no external metadata (registration falls back to image-only pseudo-georeferencing).

gps_chain_reconcile.description: Correct per-frame GPS positions that disagree with the image registration chain before placing frames (hybrid method). Fixes the periodic misregistration from sub-second trigger / GPS-sample aliasing (a frame whose logged GPS step is short/long while the imagery shows steady motion). Every correction must be confirmed by an independent high-quality match of the two frames, so frames are never moved without direct image evidence. Set false to place frames at raw GPS as before.

image_list1.description: Image-list file for camera 1: a single file of line-separated image paths (not comma-separated). Its first entry also locates the survey folder when site_folder is empty.

method.description: Registration method: "hybrid" (affine chains + rig cross-camera consensus + GPS geo-anchoring) or "metadata" (GPS footprints only, no image registration).

min_metadata_coverage.description: When require_metadata_match is set, the minimum fraction (0..1) of the image sequence that the metadata must cover. Default 1.0 (every frame).

register_scope.description: What to register: "list" (default) registers only the frames the pipeline is given (the image_list<i> files) - so a subset drawn from a larger or mixed folder is registered on its own. "folder" registers the whole survey folder - best when you want the full-survey geometry (more frames, all cross-camera/loop overlap). Chains still need a reasonably contiguous per-camera run to register well.

require_metadata.description: Fail the pipeline if no metadata file (flight_log) was provided to the registration. Default false: image-only registration is allowed.

require_metadata_match.description: Fail the pipeline if the provided metadata does not correspond to the current image sequence - fewer than min_metadata_coverage of its frames get a pose from the metadata file. Default false.

site_folder.description: Survey folder containing the per-camera image subdirectories. Empty = derive it from the first entry of "image_list1" (the streamed file_name port only carries basenames, so the folder cannot be recovered from it).

use_cache.description: Persist/reuse a full-folder registration in <site>/VIAME/ (alongside the camera folders) when the data folder is writable. A whole-folder run writes registration_<method>.npz there; any run - including a list-scope one - reuses it when its stored algorithm signature still matches, since the full-survey geometry covers a subset at higher quality. Set false to skip the cache.

average_stereo_classes.description: If true, average class labels across matched stereo track pairs so both cameras report the same species classification.

box_min_aspect_ratio.description: Minimum aspect ratio for bounding boxes (smaller dimension / larger dimension). Prevents very thin boxes when keypoints are nearly collinear. Set to 0 to disable. Default is 0.10 (10%).

box_scale_factor.description: Scale factor to expand the bounding box around keypoints when creating new detections for the right image. A value of 1.10 means 10% expansion.

calibration_file.description: Input filename for the calibration file to use

class_averaging_ignore_class.description: Optional class name to exclude from averaging when mixed with real classes. Detections whose only label is this class are separated; if non-ignored detections are also present the ignored class is excluded from the output. Empty string disables this feature.

class_averaging_method.description: Method for averaging class labels: 'weighted_average' (weight by detection confidence), 'simple_average' (equal weight per detection), or 'weighted_scaled_by_conf' (weighted average scaled by 0.1+0.9*avg_conf).

debug_epipolar_directory.description: Directory to write debug images showing epipolar search lines overlaid on the source and target images. Each keypoint match attempt writes a side-by-side image with the source point marked on the left image and the bounded epipolar curve drawn on the right image, along with any matched point. Set to empty string (default) to disable debug output.

default_depth.description: Default depth (in meters) to use when projecting left camera points to right camera for tracks that only exist in the left camera, when using the depth_projection option

depth_consistency_max_ratio.description: Maximum allowed depth ratio between head and tail keypoints when both are matched. If the deeper keypoint is more than this ratio times the shallower keypoint's depth, the deeper match is rejected (converted to a partial match with no length measurement). This catches false stereo matches where one keypoint incorrectly matched at the wrong depth. Set to 0 to disable. Default is 1.5 (50% depth difference allowed).

descriptor_extractor:type.description:
Algorithm to use for 'descriptor_extractor'.
Must be one of the following options:
	- ocv_BRIEF
	- ocv_BRISK
	- ocv_DAISY
	- ocv_FREAK
	- ocv_LATCH
	- ocv_LUCID
	- ocv_ORB
	- ocv_SIFT
	- ocv_SURF

detection_pairing_method.description: Method for pairing left/right detections that do not share the same track ID. Set to empty string (default) to disable detection pairing. Valid options: 'iou' (bounding box overlap), 'calibration' (stereo reprojection error), 'feature_matching' (visual feature detection and matching within bounding boxes), 'epipolar_iou' (project left bbox to right using depth, match by IOU), 'keypoint_projection' (project left head/tail keypoints to right, match by pixel distance).

detection_pairing_require_class_match.description: If true, only pair detections whose top class labels match (default true).

detection_pairing_threshold.description: Threshold for detection pairing. For 'iou'/'epipolar_iou' this is the minimum IOU (default 0.1). For 'calibration' this is the max reprojection error in pixels. For 'keypoint_projection' this is the max average keypoint pixel distance.

detection_pairing_use_optimal_assignment.description: If true, use greedy optimal assignment to maximize matching quality. If false, use simple sequential matching (default true).

detection_split_threshold.description: Minimum number of co-occurring frame pairings required to accept a left/right track pairing. With pairing_resolution_method='split' this is the minimum segment length; with 'most_likely' it is the minimum frame count before a pairing is considered when picking the best mutual match. Raise this to suppress spurious keypoint_projection matches in crowded scenes.

dino_crop_max_area_ratio.description: Maximum fraction of full image area that the union of left and right DINO crops may occupy. When all epipolar regions for a frame fit within this fraction, DINO runs on cropped subimages instead of the full resolution, proportionally reducing ViT inference cost. Set to 0 to disable cropping. Default 0.05 (5%). Empirically, crops above ~5% degrade DINO accuracy because medium-sized crops lose global context without sufficiently reducing the candidate space. Keep this low for robustness.

dino_model_name.description: DINO backbone model name (used when epipolar_descriptor_type is 'dino'). Supports DINOv3 (e.g., 'dinov3_vits16') and DINOv2 (e.g., 'dinov2_vitb14'). If DINOv3 weights are unavailable, automatically falls back to DINOv2. DINOv2 options: 'dinov2_vits14' (small/fast), 'dinov2_vitb14' (base, recommended), 'dinov2_vitl14' (large).

dino_threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity threshold for DINO feature matching (0.0 to 1.0). With top-K + NCC mode (default, dino_top_k > 0), this is typically 0 since NCC provides the final selection. Only used for DINO-only mode (dino_top_k=0).

dino_top_k.description: Number of top DINO candidates to pass to NCC for precise refinement. The two-stage approach (DINO top-K + NCC) combines DINO semantic robustness with NCC sub-pixel precision. Recommended value: 100. Set to 0 to use DINO-only matching without NCC refinement.

dino_weights_path.description: Optional path to local DINO model weights file. If empty, weights are downloaded from the default URL on first use.

epipolar_band_halfwidth.description: Half-width of the epipolar band for template matching search (in pixels). Set to 0 for exact epipolar line search (single row, fastest). Set to 1-3 to allow small vertical deviation to handle imperfect rectification. The search will cover (2 * epipolar_band_halfwidth + 1) rows.

epipolar_descriptor_type.description: Descriptor type for epipolar template matching. 'ncc' (default): normalized cross-correlation on grayscale patches (point-by-point). 'ncc_strip': FFT-accelerated NCC on a strip covering the epipolar bounding box. Faster than point-by-point NCC for large candidate sets, no Python required. 'dino': Two-stage DINO + NCC matching (requires Python). DINO features select the top-K semantically similar candidates, then NCC provides precise localization. This avoids NCC failures on repetitive textures while preserving sub-pixel accuracy. Set dino_top_k=0 for DINO-only mode.

epipolar_max_depth.description: Maximum depth (in camera/calibration units) for epipolar template matching. Defines the far end of the depth range sampled along the camera ray. Default is 0 (off). See epipolar_min_depth for details.

epipolar_max_disparity.description: Maximum expected disparity in pixels for epipolar template matching (corresponds to the nearest objects). See epipolar_min_disparity for details.

epipolar_min_depth.description: Minimum depth (in camera/calibration units) for epipolar template matching. Defines the near end of the depth range sampled along the camera ray. Default is 0 (off). Ignored when epipolar_min_disparity and epipolar_max_disparity are both > 0. Either disparity or depth parameters must be set for epipolar_template_matching to work.

epipolar_min_disparity.description: Minimum expected disparity in pixels for epipolar template matching (corresponds to the farthest objects). When both epipolar_min_disparity and epipolar_max_disparity are > 0, the depth range is computed automatically using: depth = focal_length * baseline / disparity. This is the recommended way to configure epipolar search range since disparity is unit-independent and can be estimated directly from the images.

epipolar_num_samples.description: Number of sample points along the epipolar line for epipolar template matching. More samples give finer search resolution but take longer.

Algorithm to use for 'feature_matcher'.
Must be one of the following options:
	- fundamental_matrix_guided
	- homography_guided
	- ocv_brute_force
	- ocv_flann_based
	- vxl_constrained

feature_search_depth.description: Depth (in meters) to use when estimating the expected location for disparity-aware feature search. If set to 0 or negative, uses the default_depth parameter instead. This allows using a different depth assumption for feature search than for the depth_projection matching method.

feature_search_radius.description: Maximum distance (in pixels) to search for feature matches around the expected location. Used for feature_descriptor and ransac_feature methods.

fundamental_matrix_estimator:type.description:
Algorithm to use for 'fundamental_matrix_estimator'.
Must be one of the following options:
	- ocv
	- vxl

length_aggregation_method.description: Method for aggregating :length= notes across matched stereo track pairs: 'none' (disabled), 'average' (simple mean), 'average_iqr' (mean with IQR outlier removal), or 'median' (median). Result is added as :avg_length= note.

length_outlier_iqr_factor.description: IQR multiplier for outlier removal when averaging lengths. Values outside [Q1 - factor*IQR, Q3 + factor*IQR] are excluded.

matching_methods.description: Comma-separated list of methods to try (in order) for finding corresponding points in right camera for left-only tracks. Methods will be tried in the order specified until one succeeds. Valid options: 'input_pairs_only' (use existing keypoints from right camera if available), 'depth_projection' (uses default_depth to project points), 'external_disparity' (uses externally provided disparity map), 'compute_disparity' (uses stereo_disparity algorithm to compute disparity from rectified images), 'template_matching' (rectifies images and searches along epipolar lines), 'epipolar_template_matching' (matching along epipolar line on unrectified images, descriptor type controlled by epipolar_descriptor_type), 'feature_descriptor' (uses vital feature detection/descriptor/matching), 'ransac_feature' (feature matching with RANSAC-based fundamental matrix filtering). Example: 'input_pairs_only,compute_disparity,depth_projection'

max_avg_surface_area.description: Maximum average bounding box area (in pixels) across track detections. Tracks with larger average area are filtered out. 0 disables this filter.

max_bbox_area_ratio.description: Maximum ratio max(L_area, R_area)/min(L_area, R_area) for a per-frame pairing. Rejects pairs whose bounding boxes differ too much in area (typical cause: coincidental same-tracker-ID matches between a small fish in one camera and a large fish or school in the other). Set to <= 0 to disable. Typical value: 3.0.

max_bbox_y_center_offset.description: Maximum |y_center_left - y_center_right| (pixels) for a per-frame left/right track pairing to be recorded in the pairing accumulator. For a near-parallel stereo rig the y-center offset equals the epipolar residual, so this rejects pairs of unrelated fish at different image heights even when their triangulation rms happens to be small. Kept as absolute pixels because detection/keypoint noise is roughly constant per-pixel — it does not scale with bbox size, so normalizing by height over-rejects small targets. Set to <= 0 to disable. Typical value: 30.

max_stereo_rms.description: Maximum acceptable stereo-triangulation RMS reprojection error (pixels) for a per-frame left/right track pairing to be recorded in the pairing accumulator. Pairs whose measurement rms exceeds this are dropped from the union-find at resolve time — this rejects false same-tracker-ID and keypoint-projection matches whose triangulation did not converge. Set to <= 0 to disable filtering. Typical value: 20.0.

max_track_length.description: Maximum number of detections per output track. Tracks longer than this are filtered out. 0 disables this filter.

min_avg_surface_area.description: Minimum average bounding box area (in pixels) across track detections. Tracks with smaller average area are filtered out. 0 disables this filter.

min_ransac_inliers.description: Minimum number of inliers required for a valid RANSAC result.

min_track_length.description: Minimum number of detections per output track. Tracks shorter than this are filtered out. 0 disables this filter.

min_track_states.description: Minimum number of track states (summed across all cameras) required before a track is included in the output. A detection in one camera counts as 1, in two cameras as 2. Measurement is still performed on every frame; this only controls which tracks appear in the output. Set to 0 to disable filtering (default).

multires_coarse_step.description: Step size (in pixels) for the coarse search pass in multi-resolution template matching. Only used when use_multires_search is enabled. Larger values are faster but may miss optimal matches. Typical values are 2-4.

output_unmatched.description: If true, output unmatched detections as separate tracks with unique IDs. If false, only output matched detection pairs.

pairing_resolution_method.description: How to resolve accumulated track pairings. 'most_likely' picks the right track with most frame co-occurrences for each left track. 'split' creates separate tracks for each consistent pairing segment.

ransac_inlier_scale.description: Inlier threshold for RANSAC fundamental matrix estimation. Points with reprojection error below this threshold are considered inliers.

record_stereo_method.description: If true, record the stereo measurement method used as an attribute on each output detection object. The attribute will be ':stereo_method=METHOD' where METHOD is one of: input_kps_used, input_kps_disparity_refined, input_kps_partial_disparity_refined, disparity_inconsistent_rejected, template_matching, epipolar_template_matching, feature_descriptor, ransac_feature, depth_projection, external_disparity, or compute_disparity.

refine_keypoints_disparity_window.description: Half-width (in pixels) of the neighborhood sampled when reading the disparity map for keypoint refinement (median over (2w+1)^2). Set to 0 for single-pixel lookup. Only applies when refine_keypoints_with_disparity is true.

refine_keypoints_max_distance.description: Maximum allowed distance between tracker and disparity-implied right keypoint, as a fraction of the left bbox max(width,height). Above this threshold the track is rejected when refine_keypoints_reject_inconsistent is true. Set to 0 to disable.

refine_keypoints_reject_inconsistent.description: If true, compare each tracker-provided right keypoint to its disparity-implied position; if the distance exceeds refine_keypoints_max_distance (normalized by L bbox size), reject the track's measurement instead of refining. Only applies when refine_keypoints_with_disparity is true.

refine_keypoints_with_disparity.description: If true and a stereo_disparity algorithm is configured, snap right keypoints of already-paired tracks to the disparity-implied match of their left counterparts. Falls back to the original right keypoint when disparity is invalid at the query location. Tracks that lacked a right keypoint are unaffected.

search_range.description: Search range (in pixels) along epipolar line for template matching.

stereo_disparity:type.description:
Algorithm to use for 'stereo_disparity'.
Must be one of the following options:
	- fast_foundation_stereo
	- fast_foundation_stereo_onnx
	- foundation_stereo
	- ocv_stereo_disparity

template_matching_disparity.description: Expected disparity (in pixels) for centering the template matching search region. If set to 0 or negative, disparity is computed automatically from default_depth using the stereo camera parameters. Set this to override the automatic computation when the expected object depth differs from default_depth.

template_matching_threshold.description: Minimum normalized correlation threshold for template matching (0.0 to 1.0). Higher values require better matches but may miss valid correspondences.

template_size.description: Template window size (in pixels) for template matching. Must be odd number.

uniqueness_ratio.description: Uniqueness ratio for epipolar NCC template matching (Lowe's ratio test). After finding the best match score, compares it to the second-best match. If second_best / best > this ratio, the match is considered ambiguous and is rejected. This prevents false matches on repetitive textures (e.g. fish scales) where multiple locations score similarly. Set to 0 to disable. Default is 0.85. Lower values are more strict (reject more ambiguous matches).

use_census_transform.description: If true, apply census transform preprocessing before template matching. Census transform compares each pixel to its neighbors creating a binary pattern, which is highly robust to illumination changes and camera gain differences between stereo cameras.

use_disparity_aware_feature_search.description: If true, use depth projection to estimate the expected location of corresponding points in the right image when using feature_descriptor or ransac_feature methods. This helps account for stereo disparity when searching for feature matches, making the search more robust for objects at varying depths.

use_disparity_hint.description: If true and SGBM disparity map is available, sample the disparity map near the query point to estimate initial disparity for template matching. This provides spatially-varying disparity estimates that can be more accurate than using a fixed default_depth for objects at varying distances.

use_distortion.description: Whether to use distortion coefficients from the calibration during rectification. If true, distortion coefficients from the calibration file are used. If false, zero distortion is assumed.

use_multires_search.description: If true, use multi-resolution search for template matching. First performs a coarse search with larger step size over the full search range, then refines around the best coarse match. This can significantly improve performance for large search ranges while maintaining accuracy.

multiplexer.description:
Multiplex incoming data into a single stream.

A mux operation reads input from a group of input ports and serializes that data to a single output port. The ports in a group are read in ASCII-betical order over the third port name component (<item>). This mux process can handle multiple collation operations. Each set of input ports is identified by a unique group name. 

Input ports are dynamically created as needed. Port names have the format 'in/<group>/<item>'. The multiplexed result of a group of input ports is placed on the output port named 'out/<group>'.

Each <group> must have at least two inputs to mux and each output port 'out/<group>' must be connected. 

This process automatically makes the input and output types for each <group> the same based on the type of the port that is first connected.

Example:
process mux :: multiplexer

# -- Connect mux set 'foo'# All inputs for a group must have the same type
connect foo_1.out       to  mux.in/foo/A
connect foo_2.out       to  mux.in/foo/B

# Create another group for the timestamp outputs.
# For convenience the group name is 'timestamp'
connect foo_1.timestamp   to mux.in/timestamp/A
connect foo_2.timestamp   to mux.in/timestamp/B

connect mux.out/foo         to bar.input # connect output of group
connect mux.out/timestamp   to bar.timestamp # connect output of group

termination_policy.description: Termination policy specifies how a data group is handled when the inputs complete. Valid values are "any" and "all". When "any" is specified, the output port for the group will complete when any of the inputs completes and the remaining active inputs will no longer be polled for data. When "all" is specified, the output port for the group will complete when all of the inputs are complete.

class_averaging_method.description: Method for averaging class labels: 'weighted_average' (weight by detection confidence), 'simple_average' (equal weight per detection), or 'weighted_scaled_by_conf' (weighted average scaled by 0.1+0.9*avg_conf).

compute_head_tail_points.description: If true, compute head and tail keypoints from the two furthest apart inlier feature matches and add them to the paired detections. default_depth.description: Default depth for projecting points between cameras. Units must match the calibration T vector (e.g. millimeters if T is in mm). When set to 0 (default), keypoint_projection uses depth-independent epipolar line distance instead, which requires no depth prior.

detection_split_threshold.description: Minimum number of co-occurring frame pairings required to accept a left/right track pairing. With pairing_resolution_method='split' this is the minimum segment length; with 'most_likely' it is the minimum frame count before a pairing is considered when picking the best mutual match. Raise this to suppress spurious keypoint_projection matches in crowded scenes.

epipolar_iou_threshold.description: Minimum IOU threshold after projecting left bounding box to right image using camera geometry. Used with 'epipolar_iou' method.

homography_inlier_threshold.description: Maximum reprojection error (in pixels) for a match to be considered an inlier when estimating the homography. Used with 'feature_matching' method.

iou_threshold.description: Minimum IOU (Intersection over Union) threshold for matching detections. Used with 'iou' method. Pairs with IOU below this value will not be matched.

length_aggregation_method.description: Method for aggregating :length= notes across matched stereo track pairs: 'none' (disabled), 'average' (simple mean), 'average_iqr' (mean with IQR outlier removal), or 'median' (median). Result is added as :avg_length= note.

length_outlier_iqr_factor.description: IQR multiplier for outlier removal when averaging lengths. Values outside [Q1 - factor*IQR, Q3 + factor*IQR] are excluded.

matching_method.description: Matching method to use. Options: 'iou' (bounding box overlap), 'calibration' (uses stereo geometry and reprojection error), 'feature_matching' (uses feature detection and matching within bounding boxes)

max_avg_surface_area.description: Maximum average bounding box area (in pixels) across track detections. Tracks with larger average area are filtered out. 0 disables this filter.

max_keypoint_distance.description: Maximum average pixel distance between projected left keypoints and right detection keypoints. Used with 'keypoint_projection' method.

max_reprojection_error.description: Maximum reprojection error (in pixels) for valid matches. Used with 'calibration' method.

max_track_length.description: Maximum number of detections per output track. Tracks longer than this are filtered out. 0 disables this filter.

min_avg_surface_area.description: Minimum average bounding box area (in pixels) across track detections. Tracks with smaller average area are filtered out. 0 disables this filter.

min_feature_match_count.description: Minimum number of feature matches required between two detection boxes to consider them a valid match. Used with 'feature_matching' method.

min_feature_match_ratio.description: Minimum ratio of feature matches to total features detected in the left box. A ratio of 0.1 means at least 10% of left features must match. Used with 'feature_matching' method.

min_homography_inlier_ratio.description: Minimum ratio of inlier matches to total matches after homography estimation. A ratio of 0.5 means at least 50% of matches must be inliers. Used with 'feature_matching' method.

min_inliers_for_head_tail.description: Minimum number of inlier feature matches required to compute head/tail points. If fewer inliers are found, no head/tail points will be added to the detection.

min_track_length.description: Minimum number of detections per output track. Tracks shorter than this are filtered out. 0 disables this filter.

pairing_resolution_method.description: How to resolve accumulated track pairings. 'most_likely' picks the right track with most frame co-occurrences for each left track. 'split' creates separate tracks for each consistent pairing segment.

require_class_match.description: If true, only detections with the same class label can be matched.

use_homography_filtering.description: If true, estimate a homography between matched features and reject outliers. This helps filter spurious matches that don't follow a consistent geometric transformation. Used with 'feature_matching' method.

use_optimal_assignment.description: If true, use optimal (greedy) assignment to maximize matching quality. If false, use simple greedy matching in order of left detections.
